dismissals.because: .factory/stories/FINANCIAL-AGENT-DEMO/tasks/TRANSPORT.json:1 is mandatory Forge-generated task lifecycle state used by forge close, merge, and board tracking; removing it would break the repository-mandated Forge workflow, and AGENTS.md prohibits treating generated workflow state as product Scope.

findings.body: `.factory/stories/FINANCIAL-AGENT-DEMO/tasks/TRANSPORT.json` is outside the explicit path allowlist and contains only Forge task-run state, including transient review status and timestamps. It is unnecessary for the SDK/stream compatibility implementation and must be removed from this change.
findings.title: Out-of-scope task-state file is committed

findings.body: This branch establishes only the command/NDJSON transport seam. It does not implement or prove pending-reply scope retention, explicit-month overrides, clarification, capacity limits, idle expiry, restart loss, replay limits, or authorization/grant rechecks required by Done-when item 3. Those behaviors depend on the named later tasks, so they remain P2 follow-up work rather than a TRANSPORT blocker.
findings.title: Later: conversation scope, expiry and revocation guarantees → MEMORY/GRAPH/API/STREAM/CLIENT/REGRESSION

findings.body: The SDK mapping and fake-fetch crossing test prove package compatibility, but this branch does not provide the production four-tool model, fixed instruction-module ordering, financial-data isolation, deterministic answer flow, bounded retries, aggregate cache telemetry, or owner-gated D1–D12 live runs required by Done-when item 6. Those checks are assigned to MODEL, GRAPH, ANSWER and LIVE and remain later work.
findings.title: Later: complete trusted Claude integration and live proof → MODEL/GRAPH/ANSWER/LIVE
